correctness.rationale: Addition theorem identifies the normalized zonal Gegenbauer Gram with a positive multiple of E_ell E_ell*. Four-Walsh-character blocks on coordinate pairs split even product/constant sectors from odd sign sectors. The pair-index constant sector reduces exactly to J(n,2), whose adjacency eigenvalues 2(n-2),n-4,-2 give three even eigenvalues. Odd signs split into n independent (n-1)-stars. The listed sector multiplicities sum to n(n-1), with the same number of antipodal zeros, and reproduce trace 2n(n-1). Recurrence-based rational low-degree factorizations give n=8 (ell=4) and n=16 (ell=6) zeros. Independently computed full Gram matrices for n=5/6/7/8/9/16 at relevant degrees and compared sorted eigenvalues (max errors <2e-14). Degree-zero and parity-zero ranks included; no claim that all higher-degree exceptional dimensions have been enumerated.
residual_risks: All-order spectrum is exact but no simplified census of possible higher-degree resonances is proved.

value.rationale: The exact spectrum and rank of a natural crystallographic root orbit give sharp spherical-harmonic interpolation frame bounds and explicitly identify two meaningful dimension-dependent low-degree resonances. This is more than restating a generic association scheme: the concrete all-degree eigenvalues and loss multiplicities answer natural sampling questions.
residual_risks: The result is limited to its exactly stated object/parameters and has not been verified by an external human expert.
